title: Reading Drill — Recording seasonal light for a mural — Building a comparison
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Recording seasonal light for a mural — Building a comparison
passages.body:
**A** The mural planner had been asked to investigate paint colours looking different across the same wall in Cairnford. Its first task was to decide which signs of improvement could be compared between sites. It settled on colour differences at set hours, because the same measure could be applied in the original setting and at a second location.

**B** During a ten-week comparison, the team used photographic comparisons at both places. It recorded outcomes separately for each site. Because nearby buildings casting shadows might influence the figures, the team used a column in the record to show when that condition was present. The surveys included quiet periods as well as busy ones.

**C** The team then put forward a test of sample panels in place. Its report asked for another comparison after the change had been tried. This would distinguish a genuine effect from an improvement that could have occurred anyway. The report did not assume that the more successful site before the change would be the better site afterwards.
